items.title: Tom Scott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2022 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I got Plas Johnson; Jackie Kelso, another wonderful saxophone player; Bill Perkins, another saxophone player.

ctx.x: At what point in Steely Dan recordings did you get the tunes that you were going to add horn section parts to?

Right. Well I had met Walter Becker, one half of Steely Dan of course, through a mutual friend. And so I got a call from him saying, “Look we are working on our new album” [Steely Dan] and I wondered if you could come down and listen and maybe write some horn arrangements.” I was like great. Because Steely Dan was already, you know, a very hot property. So I walked into Village Recorders in West Los Angeles and I met Donald Fagan and their producer — I can’t think of his name right now.
